- [RARC.5.2.3] **Fact identity.** Two facts are equal iff all their
  slot values compare equal ([LDET.3.2.4]), by the comparison of
  [LFAC.2.5.1]. The engine must suppress a no-op reassertion of a fact of a
  `logical` schema, and only of one ([LFAC.1.4.4]). Facts of a `ttl` schema
  accumulate ([LFAC.1.3.2]): two equal asserts are two live facts, each with
  its own expiry.

  **The suppression is a working-memory discipline and does not reach
  the recorder** — a no-op reassertion is still an arriving input and
  is still written as a `FactAssert` ([RFCS.6.7]). Dropping it would leave a
  trace carrying the pump ([RFCS.22]) but not the input that provoked it.
